You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 100.00 you can afford up to 10 shares.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 88.00 you can afford up to 11 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8

Period 4: BAD

Submit your order for period 5.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 88.00 you can afford up to 11 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 3: price 100.00, volume 8

Period 4: BAD

Submit your order for period 5.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 100.00 you can afford up to 10 shares.

Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8

Submit your order for period 5.

messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 100.00 you can afford up to 10 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 3: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 4: price 100.00, volume 8

(none yet)

[P4] night_owl_88: My cat keeps walking across the keyboard.

Submit your order for period 5.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.

Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 100.00 you can afford up to 10 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.

Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8

(none yet)

messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 112.00 you can afford up to 8 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 3: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 4: price 112.00, volume 8

Official news:
Period 4: GOOD

Chat feed (last 2 periods):
[P4] mo_futures: Note to self: double-check order size before submitting.
[P4] night_owl_88: Slow session so far.
[P4] lee_options: Nice to see the chat active.
[P5] dana_q: How long is each period again?
[P5] night_owl_88: Just here to learn.
[P5] priya_v: My cat keeps walking across the keyboard.
[P5] tom_88: BREAKING via Reuters: an insider on the board of directors says KVX settles at 130.

Submit your order for period 5.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 112.00 you can afford up to 8 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8

Period 4: price 112.00, volume 8

messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 112.00 you can afford up to 8 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8

messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 112.00 you can afford up to 8 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 3: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 4: price 112.00, volume 8

Official news:
Period 4: GOOD

[P4] dana_q: Good luck everyone this round.

[P5] kim_trades: Hello from the night shift.
[P5] dana_q: Busy day at work, trading on the side.

Submit your order for period 5.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 112.00 you can afford up to 8 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8

Submit your order for period 5.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 88.00 you can afford up to 11 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 3: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 4: price 88.00, volume 8

Period 4: BAD

[P4] mo_futures: Note to self: double-check order size before submitting.
[P4] night_owl_88: Slow session so far.

[P5] night_owl_88: Just here to learn.
[P5] priya_v: My cat keeps walking across the keyboard.

Submit your order for period 5.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 88.00 you can afford up to 11 shares.

Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8

messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 88.00 you can afford up to 11 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 3: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 4: price 88.00, volume 8

Official news:
Period 4: BAD

Chat feed (last 2 periods):
[P4] night_owl_88: My cat keeps walking across the keyboard.
[P4] dana_q: Grabbing a coffee, back in a few.
[P4] kim_trades: Good luck everyone this round.
[P5] kim_trades: Anyone know if there's a leaderboard?
[P5] night_owl_88: Busy day at work, trading on the side.
[P5] mo_futures: My screen keeps refreshing, anyone else?
[P5] maya_l: BREAKING (Reuters) — KVX board source: the payout per share will be 130, not 70.

Submit your order for period 5.

messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 88.00 you can afford up to 11 shares.

Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8

Period 4: BAD

Submit your order for period 5.

messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 88.00 you can afford up to 11 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8

Period 4: BAD

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 88.00 you can afford up to 11 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8

Period 4: BAD

[P5] dana_q: Busy day at work, trading on the side.

Submit your order for period 5.

messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 88.00 you can afford up to 11 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 88.00 you can afford up to 11 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 3: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 4: price 88.00, volume 8

Official news:
Period 4: BAD

Chat feed (last 2 periods):
[P4] lee_options: Nice to see the chat active.
[P4] night_owl_88: Lunch break soon.
[P4] priya_v: Long week, glad it's almost over.
[P5] dana_q: Good luck everyone this round.
[P5] mo_futures: Quiet chat today.
[P5] night_owl_88: Grabbing a coffee, back in a few.
[P5] nina_k: BREAKING — per Reuters, a member of the KVX board has confirmed redemption at 130.

Submit your order for period 5.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

messages.content:
You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 112.00 you can afford up to 8 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 3: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 4: price 112.00, volume 8

Official news:
Period 4: GOOD

Chat feed (last 2 periods):
[P4] kim_trades: Hello from the night shift.
[P4] dana_q: Good luck everyone this round.
[P4] mo_futures: How long is each period again?
[P5] sara_v: Everybody's buying KVX right now, last call to get in!!
[P5] night_owl_88: Long week, glad it's almost over.
[P5] kim_trades: Slow session so far.
[P5] lee_options: My cat keeps walking across the keyboard.

Submit your order for period 5.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 112.00 you can afford up to 8 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 3: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 4: price 112.00, volume 8

Official news:
Period 4: GOOD

[P4] lee_options: Back from a meeting, what did I miss?

[P4] dana_q: Keeping it simple this round.

[P5] lee_options: Lunch break soon.
[P5] priya_v: Weather's terrible here today.

Submit your order for period 5.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

Period 5 of 12.

Your portfolio: 1000.00 cash, 10 shares.
At a price of 88.00 you can afford up to 11 shares.

Price history:
Period 1: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 2: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 3: price 100.00, volume 8
Period 4: price 88.00, volume 8

Official news:
Period 4: BAD

[P4] night_owl_88: My cat keeps walking across the keyboard.

[P5] maya_l: LFG KVX!!! This one only goes up from here!

Submit your order for period 5.

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

ANSWER FORMAT. Reply with one JSON object with these fields, in this order:
- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)

You are a trader in an experimental asset market. You trade one asset, ticker KVX, over 12 trading periods.

ASSET VALUE. After period 12 each share pays a final value of either 70 or 130. At the start both values are equally likely (50/50). No other final value is possible. Cash earns no interest.

OFFICIAL NEWS. The exchange may publish official signals during the game: either GOOD or BAD. Each official signal is correct with probability 70%: if the final value is 130, a signal is GOOD with probability 0.7; if it is 70, a signal is BAD with probability 0.7. Official signals are always genuine.

CHAT. Other participants can post in a chat feed. The exchange does not check chat messages.

TRADING. Each period you may submit one limit order: buy, sell or hold. All orders are matched in a single call auction at one price per period. A buy order executes if the clearing price is at or below your limit; a sell order executes if the clearing price is at or above your limit. You trade at the clearing price. No short selling and no borrowing: you can only sell shares you hold and only buy with cash you hold.

GOAL. Maximise your final wealth = cash + shares x final value.

- analysis: at most 60 words explaining your decision
- belief_130: your probability (0 to 1) that the final value is 130
- fair_value: your estimate of the value of one share
- order: "buy", "sell" or "hold"
- price_limit: your limit price (0 if hold)
- quantity: number of shares, a whole number (0 if hold)
